name: claude-cli-iii-integration
description: Agent profiles and skills from a running iii engine's iii-directory worker, over MCP. Works inside the claude-code worker and in a standalone claude.

engine_url.title: iii engine URL
engine_url.description: WebSocket address of the iii engine (ws://host:port, host:port or a port). Leave empty to use III_URL or auto-detect on 127.0.0.1/localhost ports 49134-49136.
